items.title: Howard Johnson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2019
items.q: Bull Moose Jackson for instance. If you listen to his stuff, if I listen to his stuff now it’s very advanced from a lot of the other stuff. He was a good saxophone player.

ctx.x: Um hum. And people like that. Bull Moose Jackson for instance. If you listen to his stuff, if I listen to his stuff now it’s very advanced from a lot of the other stuff. He was a good saxophone player. Louis Jordan was a good saxophone player. And I got into the bebop thing as well, which was the same time, very bebop, ’50, ’48, ’45, and it all had pretty much the same value to me except I was a little more deeply touched by the bebop guys.
Were you trying to play that music on the baritone sax?
